rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Acts as a secure gateway between AI agents and EVM-compatible blockchains. Provides vault-based private key management, rule-enforced access control, and API proxying for contract deployment, chain state reading, and block explorer queries. Agents interact with blockchain without direct access to secrets, with audit logging and configurable transaction policies.
